wisp.extras.fullbright.tooltip: Show blocks and entities at full light, even in dark areas.
wisp.extras.dynamic_lights.tooltip: Torches and other light sources held, dropped or on fire light the blocks around them.
wisp.extras.own_name_tag.tooltip: Shows your name above your head in third person, as other players see it. Hidden when the server hides your team's names or you're invisible.
wisp.extras.hide_block_particles.tooltip: Hides the debris particles that burst from a broken block and crumble off the one you mine. Other particles stay.
wisp.extras.auto_reconnect.tooltip: Rejoins a server after a lost connection or a restart, never after a kick or ban.
wisp.extras.ui_sound_reserve.tooltip: Sounds in the world leave 16 of the 247 sound channels free, so a flood of them (a big explosion) can't silence menu clicks.
wisp.extras.music_page.tooltip: Music & Sounds gets a Music... page: play any built-in track now, or turn one off so the game stops picking it. Nothing changes until you turn a track off.
wisp.extras.mouse_tweaks.tooltip: Right-drag places one per slot, left-drag gathers the held item, Shift + left-drag moves every slot.
wisp.extras.mouse_tweaks_wheel.tooltip: Down sends one item of the slot to the other side, up brings one back.
wisp.extras.sort.tooltip: Sorts the inventory, chests, barrels, ender chests and shulker boxes in creative tab order, merging stacks.
wisp.extras.sort_key.tooltip: Sorts the part under the cursor. Click, then press a key; Escape unbinds it.
wisp.extras.no_ai.tooltip: Hides and turns off every AI feature: agent control, wisp-ctl and the MCP servers. The launcher's switch too.
wisp.extras.agent_control.tooltip: Your own AI agent can play this game through wisp-ctl or an MCP client, on this computer only.
wisp.extras.discord_presence.tooltip: Shows Playing Wisp on your Discord profile while Discord runs: menus, single player or multiplayer, the dimension and the time played. Never a world's name or a server's address.
Sets the three below full screen, one te: Sets the three below full screen, one test picture at a time.
A key that opens this screen from the ga: A key that opens this screen from the game. Not bound at first.
Your display didn't say how bright it ge: Your display didn't say how bright it gets: calibrate to set it up.
Already set up for your display. Only ca: Already set up for your display. Only calibrate if HDR looks wrong.
Puts Peak Brightness and Paper White bac: Puts Peak Brightness and Paper White back to your display's setup.
Set up for your display. Leave on Auto u: Set up for your display. Leave on Auto unless it looks wrong.
Lower it until the logo just disappears: Lower it until the logo just disappears into the black.
Raise it until the logo just disappears: Raise it until the logo just disappears into the bright square.
Make the card a white that's comfortable: Make the card a white that's comfortable to look at for a long time, in the light you play in.

wisp.friends.title: Play with Friends
wisp.friends.hint: Friends paste the code after the title screen's Friends button, in Direct Connection, or on the launcher's Play page.
wisp.friends.share_intro: Share this world behind an invite code: it opens to LAN, and friends on the internet join with the code. No server of ours is involved.
wisp.friends.short_code_changed: Someone kept trying a wrong short code, so it changed.
wisp.friends.code_ready: Your invite code is ready: Game Menu, Play with Friends. Copy it and send it to your friends.
wisp.friends.finding_route: Finding how friends can reach you…
wisp.extras.chat_animation.tooltip: A new chat line slides in from the left while it fades in, instead of appearing whole.
wisp.extras.chat_indicator.tooltip: The coloured bar at the left of a chat line.
wisp.extras.wheel_cycles_settings.toolti: The scroll wheel over a button in the settings changes its value, as in vanilla. Off, the wheel only scrolls the list.
wisp.extras.pack_browser.tooltip: Select Resource Packs gets an Add button that searches Modrinth and installs a pack into your packs folder. Off, the game never contacts Modrinth.
wisp.extras.splitscreen.tooltip: In a world, another controller can join as a new player: press A when it asks, then pick a profile and where to play.

wisp.splitscreen.setup.switch_disabled: Splitscreen turns off once the others have left (their pause menu).

wisp.splitscreen.setup.help.names: Each player's name in the corner of their view.

wisp.extras.cosmetics_mine.tooltip: Hidden: every Wisp player sees you without your cosmetics, you included. The same switch as the launcher's Wardrobe.
wisp.extras.cosmetics_others.tooltip: What other Wisp players wear: everything, only their name tag styles, or nothing. Hidden, the game never asks what they wear.
wisp.extras.cosmetics_auras.tooltip: Auras and trails other players wear. Off by default.
wisp.fps.tooltip: Show frame rate and frame-time lows.
wisp.apple_skin.tooltip: Show hunger, saturation and held food restoration.
wisp.smart_f3.tooltip: Use a compact debug panel with coordinates and frame rate.
wisp.shulker_preview.tooltip: Show a read-only contents grid in shulker box tooltips.
wisp.armor_status.tooltip: Show equipped armor and remaining durability.
wisp.mod_menu.tooltip: Right Shift opens the built-in client features menu.
wisp.fast_items.tooltip: Draw one model per dropped stack to reduce rendering work.
wisp.hitboxes.tooltip: Show entity hitboxes without opening the debug overlay.
wisp.wisp_hud.tooltip: Use optional sunset-accented glass HUD panels.
wisp.resource_pack.empty: No assets found. This pack cannot change textures.
wisp.module.hud_cps.tooltip: Shows your left and right clicks per second.
wisp.module.hud_ping.tooltip: Shows your latency to the server, as the player list reports it.
wisp.module.hud_direction.tooltip: Shows the compass direction you face and your yaw.
wisp.module.hud_biome.tooltip: Shows the biome you stand in.
wisp.module.hud_server.tooltip: Shows the server address, or Singleplayer.
wisp.module.hud_speed.tooltip: Shows your horizontal speed in blocks per second.
wisp.module.hud_day_time.tooltip: Shows the in-game time of day and the day number.
wisp.module.hud_effects.tooltip: Lists your status effects with their level and time left.
wisp.module.hud_durability.tooltip: Shows the durability left on the item in your hand.
wisp.module.hud_arrows.tooltip: Shows how many arrows you carry while holding a bow or crossbow.
wisp.module.always_day.tooltip: Draws the sky and light at noon whatever the time. Only you see it: the world's time, mobs and the server are unchanged.
wisp.module.item_physics.tooltip: Dropped items lie flat on the ground instead of floating and spinning; blocks stand still. Only you see it.
wisp.module.arrow_trails.tooltip: Flying arrows leave a trail of glowing sparks. Only you see it.
wisp.module.target_crosshair.tooltip: The crosshair turns red while it is on a mob or player you can hit.
wisp.module.freelook.tooltip: Hold Left Alt to look around your character in third person without turning it.
wisp.module.health_indicators.tooltip: Shows the health of mobs and players near you above their heads.
wisp.module.damage_numbers.tooltip: Shows how much damage a mob or player takes, or heals, as a number that rises from it.
wisp.module.tnt_timer.tooltip: Shows the seconds left on lit TNT above it.
wisp.module.hit_info.tooltip: Shows the reach of your last hit and your combo: hits in a row, each within two seconds of the last.
wisp.module.item_highlighter.tooltip: Dropped items glow with an outline in their rarity's colour, so you see them through walls.
wisp.waypoints.none: No waypoints here. /wp add <name> marks where you stand.
wisp.module.chat_highlights.tooltip: A message that names you gets a gold bar and a ping.
wisp.module.chat_peek.tooltip: Hold H to see the chat history without opening the chat.
wisp.module.waypoints.tooltip: Mark places with /wp add <name> (also remove, list, clear). Each shows through walls with its distance, per world and dimension.
wisp.extras.hud_editor.tooltip: Move, scale and colour the information and Armor Status panels: drag them, scroll over one to scale. In a world only.
wisp.hud_editor.title: HUD Editor
wisp.hud_editor.hint: Drag a panel to move it, scroll over it to scale.
wisp.hud_editor.hint2: Right click a panel to put it back in its corner.
wisp.module.inventory_search.tooltip: A search box over the inventory and chests: items that don't match what you type are dimmed.

wisp.menu.feature.skin_layers.tooltip: Draws the outer layer of player skins in 3D.

wisp.menu.friends.none_hint: Type a Minecraft name above and press Add. They need to have opened Wisp once.
wisp.menu.friends.problem_hint: Friends belong to your Minecraft account and live on the Wisp server.
